answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The sonnet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the copper.
